title: ARG Allocated Wallet
description: Short-lived cryptographically bounded transaction passport issued to an autonomous agent execution tree

wallet_id.description: Unique identifier for this wallet instance

execution_tree_id.description: Identifier of the agent execution tree this wallet is bound to

maximum_token_quantum.description: Finite spending cap for this execution tree

token_limit.description: Maximum tokens consumable across the entire execution tree

cost_limit_usd.description: Maximum spend in USD. Proxy gate terminates execution when reached.

tokens_consumed.description: Running total of tokens consumed. Updated by proxy gate.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds. Wallet self-invalidates after this window regardless of task completion.

dependency_graph_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the allow list of authorized external models, endpoints, and cloud resource paths
